title: Main Takeaways, Exercises and Extra- Curriculum

cues.en: A big two thumbs up for how well our first ever transfer learning model is going.
cues.zh: 第一個遷移學習模型表現這麼好，給兩個大大的讚。

cues.en: But let's now jump into here.
cues.zh: 現在進到這裡。

cues.en: We're going to jump into PyTorch transfer learning V2 for now.
cues.zh: 目前叫 PyTorch Transfer Learning V2。

cues.en: But just so you're aware, this will probably not be V2 by the time you watch it.
cues.zh: 不過提醒一下，等你看時可能不再叫 V2。

cues.en: You can just go to PyTorch Transfer Learning and if we scroll down here, we've got the main takeaways.
cues.zh: 直接到 PyTorch Transfer Learning，往下有主要重點。

cues.en: So we've kind of hashed over this stuff already, but and you've seen it in practice, which is more important.
cues.zh: 這些大致談過，也實際看過，這更重要。

cues.en: But transfer learning often allows you to get good results with a relatively small amount of custom data.
cues.zh: 遷移學習通常能用相對少量的自訂資料，得到好結果。

cues.en: And knowing the power of transfer learning, it's now a good idea to ask at the start of every problem.
cues.zh: 了解它的力量後，現在每次開始一個問題時，都值得問，

cues.en: Does an existing well performing model exist?
cues.zh: 有沒有已存在、表現良好的模型，

cues.en: For my current problem?
cues.zh: 適合目前問題？

cues.en: And recall that we went through a few places to get pre-trained models.
cues.zh: 記得，介紹過幾個取得預訓練模型的地方。

cues.en: You can have a look at those here then if we go back.
cues.zh: 可以在這裡看，再回來。

cues.en: When using a pre-trained model, you have to ensure that your custom data is formatted and processed.
cues.zh: 使用預訓練模型，必須確保自訂資料的格式與處理方式，

cues.en: We did that using transforms in the same way that the original model was trained on.
cues.zh: 我們用 transforms 做到，和原模型訓練資料相同。

cues.en: Otherwise you may get degraded performance.
cues.zh: 否則表現可能下降。

cues.en: And the same thing goes for when predicting on custom data.
cues.zh: 預測自訂資料也一樣。

cues.en: So we saw how we had to write a big function to format our own custom data when making predictions for the model.
cues.zh: 所以看過，必須寫一個大函數，在模型預測時整理自己的自訂資料。

cues.en: And we rehashed on this.
cues.zh: 也重複談過。

cues.en: There are several different places to find pre-trained models.
cues.zh: 有好幾個地方能找預訓練模型。

cues.en: So a big takeaway from this is when you're starting a new machine learning problem, if you want to leverage the power of transfer learning.
cues.zh: 因此主要重點，是開始新的機器學習問題，想利用遷移學習的力量時，

cues.en: Ask yourself the question Does an existing well-performing model exist for my problem?
cues.zh: 問自己：「有沒有已存在、表現良好的模型，適合我的問題？」
